label: Bible Study
prompt: I go the way of all the earth: be thou _____ therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verse: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
note: David's deathbed charge to young Solomon — 'be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the _____ of the Almighty hath given me life.
verse: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
note: Elihu reminds Job that the Spirit made him and the Almighty's breath gave him life — every breath is a gift.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them _____, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verse: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
note: Heaven's elders come with harps and golden vials full of odours — which turn out to be the prayers of saints.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our _____ is sacrificed for us:
verse: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
note: Paul reads the Exodus feast onto the cross: clear out the old leaven, because the Passover lamb is already offered.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He shall see of the _____ of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verse: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
note: 'He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied' — birth-pain language for the harvest of the cross.
